summary: Admin Panel for Job Role & Skill Management with Internet Identity authentication, admin permission levels, and full CRUD operations for managing job roles and their required skills with proficiency levels
architectural_notes: Backend: Motoko for data storage and management of job roles and skills
Frontend: React with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS for admin UI
Authentication: Internet Identity integration for secure admin access
Data model: Job roles contain multiple skills, each with proficiency levels (beginner/intermediate/advanced)
Access control: Permission-based system to restrict admin panel access

existing_features.title: Enforce admin-only access to the AdminPanel page by verifying the user's Principal has admin permissions using the backend admin registry.
Display skill proficiency levels in the AdminPanel job role cards and in the JobRoleSelector component so users can see the required proficiency for each skill.
Update the skill matching and gap analysis logic to consider proficiency levels when comparing resume skills against job role requirements, matching both skill name and proficiency level.

new_feature_requests.summary: Admin Panel with full CRUD operations for job roles and skills
Skill proficiency level management (beginner, intermediate, advanced)
Internet Identity authentication for admin panel
Admin permission levels for access control
Add admin permission levels to the backend by creating an admin registry that stores Principal IDs of users with admin access. Include methods to add, remove, and check admin status.
Update the JobRoleForm component to include proficiency level selection (beginner, intermediate, advanced) for each skill when adding or editing skills for a job role.
